title: The nest wakes
note: The campaign's first fight gets a reserved track, not a shuffle from the battle pool (Ingram, 2026-09-17: 'carefully pick and choose... some songs unique, special, or associated with particular... events'). Fired directly off the 'the-fight' beat rather than waiting on a live Foundry Combat -- the more reliable path for a scene run straight off the Scene Runner, and it still works exactly the same way if the GM does track initiative. The soundscape's own combat.track binds the same asset as a second, automatic path.
